mapper.update: MERGE INTO LGCOM_ROLE_M a USING ( SELECT #{systemCode} AS system_code , #{moduleCode} AS module_code , #{roleCode} AS role_code , #{roleName} AS role_name , #{roleDesc} AS role_desc , TO_DATE(#{applyStartDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_start_date , TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AS apply_end_date , #{sessionUserId} AS sess_user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.role_code = b.role_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET system_code = b.system_code , module_code = b.module_code , role_name = b.role_name , role_desc = b.role_desc , apply_start_date = b.apply_start_date , apply_end_date = b.apply_end_date , last_updated_by = b.sess_user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(system_code,module_code,role_code,role_name,role_desc,apply_start_date,apply_end_date,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES(b.system_code,b.module_code,b.role_code,b.role_name,b.role_desc,b.apply_start_date,b.apply_end_date,b.sess_user_id,SYSDATE,b.sess_user_id,SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N lrm WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = lrm.role_code)
DELETE FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N lur WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = lur.role_code)
DELETE FROM LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N lrb WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = lrb.role_code)
DELETE FROM LGCOM_ROLE_HRM_ORGANIZATION_N lrh WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = lrh.role_code)
DELETE FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_ACCESS_N pan WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = pan.role_code)
DELETE FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_ACCESS_N ctca WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND role_code = ctca.role_code)
